positive_findings: The LAW-12 scenario card suite (configs/workflow_gate_scenarios, 7 cards G1-G7) is REAL and ENFORCING: observed live, all 7 cards validated, 'SCENARIOS ok ... -> FAIL exit 2' per card, plus a pass_control, exit 0.

githooks/pre-push is the best-tested surface in the repo: hook bytes are read at test time, not duplicated, and test_scenarios_gate_hook_pin.py contains a genuine falsifier (test_case_flip_is_caught) that requires a case regression to break a match.
All 7 gates are stdlib-only (no mag/ imports) — they can run anywhere, and their tests do not inherit the fleet's dependency surface.
tests/conftest.py has a suite-wide autouse isolation fixture (B2-336) making memory/log pollution structurally impossible rather than per-test discipline.
conftest.py creates basetemp up front, with a comment recording that its absence once caused 56 suite failures — institutional memory in the harness.
